title: Neon Ledger Persistence Boundary
description: Persist the already-defined append-only proposal ledger in the existing Dreaming Worker Neon boundary without coupling ledger history to Session Search shard storage or Mastra internal tables.
context: Persist the already-defined append-only proposal ledger in the existing Dreaming Worker Neon boundary without coupling ledger history to Session Search shard storage or Mastra internal tables.

rules:
`proposal_records` stores immutable Proposal v1 records with exact proposal, route and source/provenance fingerprints.

`supersession_events` stores immutable links from one existing proposal record to another. PostgreSQL foreign keys enforce that both endpoints exist and a CHECK rejects self-supersession.

Database persistence does not replace application-ledger validation. The application contract remains responsible for content-addressed ID recomputation, exact Proposal v1 fingerprint verification and supersession-cycle detection before insert.

The future ChatGPT-facing route should remain inside the Session Search product surface while preserving authority separation:

`Session Search tool -> bounded Dreaming Worker ledger reader -> dw_ledger`.

Session Search MUST NOT receive the Dreaming Worker runtime database credential. A future tool such as `session_hypotheses` should expose a bounded read-only representation whose results are explicitly marked `DERIVED_ONLY` and are not merged invisibly into ordinary source/shard search hits.

scenarios.requirement: Ledger and Mastra storage are separate
scenarios.name: Ledger schema is inspected
then: ledger objects are created only under dw_ledger
AND no ledger table is created under dw_issue23

scenarios.name: Runtime role grants are inspected
then: dw_runtime_issue23 has SELECT and INSERT only for ledger tables
AND has no CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, REFERENCES or TRIGGER ledger authority

scenarios.name: Ledger row authority is checked
then: proposal and supersession rows enforce authority = DERIVED_ONLY

scenarios.name: Supersession constraints are checked
then: both supersession endpoints use foreign keys to proposal_records(record_id)

scenarios.requirement: Session Search remains a read interface, not the ledger owner
scenarios.name: Future read seam is reviewed
then: future Session Search access uses a bounded read seam
AND Session Search receives no Dreaming Worker runtime database credential
AND derived ledger results remain distinguishable from source/shard search hits
